sentences.text: Robert James Ritchie -LRB- born January 17 , 1971 -RRB- , known professionally as Kid Rock , is an American singer , rapper , songwriter , musician , record producer , and actor .	Rock	Rock music
His 1998 album Devil Without a Cause sold 14 million copies worldwide .	Devil Without a Cause	Devil Without a Cause
He is a five-time Grammy Award nominee and has sold 25 million albums in the U.S. according to Nielsen SoundScan .	Grammy Award	Grammy Award	Nielsen SoundScan	Nielsen SoundScan
The RIAA certified him selling 23.5 million albums .

He has sold over 35 million records worldwide and he was Soundscan 's number-one selling male solo musician of the 2000s , selling 17.6 million albums ; he was 17th overall for the decade .	Soundscan	Soundscan
Rock performed rap and hip hop with five releases between 1990 and 1997 , including a reissue and an EP .	Rock	Rock music	hip hop	hip hop	EP	Extended play

After signing a recording contract with Atlantic Records in 1998 , he gained commercial success in the rap rock genre behind the singles `` Bawitdaba '' , `` Cowboy '' and `` Only God Knows Why '' -LRB- the latter foreshadowing his move into country rock -RRB- .	rap rock	rap rock	country	country music	Atlantic	Atlantic Records	recording contract	recording contract	Atlantic Records	Atlantic Records	Bawitdaba	Bawitdaba	Cowboy	Cowboy (Kid Rock song)	Only God Knows Why	Only God Knows Why	rock	Rock music

After the success of Devil Without a Cause in 2000 , he released The History of Rock , a compilation of remixed and remastered versions of songs from previous albums as well as the hit rock single , `` American Bad Ass '' .	Rock	Rock music	Devil Without a Cause	Devil Without a Cause	The History of Rock	The History of Rock	American Bad Ass	American Bad Ass	rock	Rock music
Rock 's follow-up records became more rock - , country - , and blues-oriented , starting with 2001 's Cocky .	Rock	Rock music	country	country music	rock	Rock music	blues	blues	Cocky	Cocky (album)

His collaboration with Sheryl Crow on the song `` Picture '' was his first country hit and biggest pop hit in the US to date charting at No. 4 on the Hot 100 .	country	country music	Sheryl Crow	Sheryl Crow	Picture	Picture (song)
After 2003 's Kid Rock and 2006 's Live Trucker sales declined from the previous releases , he then released Rock n Roll Jesus in 2007 .	Rock	Rock music	Rock n Roll Jesus	Rock n Roll Jesus
The album featured the song `` All Summer Long '' , which charted at No. 1 in eight countries across Europe and Australia .	All Summer Long	All Summer Long (Kid Rock song)

In 2010 , he released Born Free , which featured an eponymous song that became the political campaign theme of Mitt Romney , the Republican nominee for President of the United States in the 2012 election .
